newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans steady in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans steady in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine soybeans were unchanged in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with prices supported by a firmer Chicago, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for May soybeans in Buenos Aires were unchanged at $295. Forward sunflower seed slipped as some prospects for export oil sales fell through. April sunseed lost $3 to $223. Buenos Aires maize fell $1 to $111 in slow trade, as the harvest loomed. Bahia Blanca wheat lost $2 to $152, with export demand slack.
